name: browser-use
headline: mailflow: Customer Support Emails
short_description: Multi Generative AI agents for customer support email automation built with Golang, Google-GenAi and Customgraph solution
author: zaynkorai

sections.overview: The mailflow skill is designed to automate customer support email processes using multi-generative AI agents. Built with Golang, Google-GenAi, and a Customgraph solution, this Claude Code skill allows teams to streamline their email workflows, reducing the manual effort involved in handling customer inquiries. By leveraging AI automation, mailflow can intelligently respond to common queries, categorize emails, and escalate issues when necessary, ensuring that customer support teams can focus on more complex tasks. One of the key benefits of mailflow is its ability to save time by automating repetitive email tasks. Although the exact time savings are currently unknown, the efficiency gained from automating email responses can significantly enhance productivity within customer support departments. By implementing mailflow, organizations can expect to reduce response times and improve customer satisfaction, as inquiries are handled promptly and accurately. This skill is particularly beneficial for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who are looking to optimize their workflows and enhance their customer engagement strategies. Mailflow is suitable for teams involved in customer support, particularly those who manage high volumes of emails. Product managers looking to improve customer experience and developers interested in integrating AI solutions into their workflows will find this skill invaluable. For example, a customer support team could utilize mailflow to automatically respond to frequently asked questions, allowing agents to dedicate their time to more complex customer issues. Additionally, businesses can implement this skill to analyze email data for insights, improving overall customer interaction strategies. With an intermediate level of difficulty, implementing mailflow can be accomplished in approximately 30 minutes, making it accessible for teams looking to enhance their AI-first workflows quickly. While the skill is not yet verified and has a moderate GTM relevance, its potential for transforming customer support processes through AI automation makes it a noteworthy addition to any organization’s toolkit. By adopting mailflow, teams can embrace the future of workflow automation and improve their operational efficiency.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/zaynkorai/mailflow`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a customer support agent for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Use the provided [DATA] to respond to customer emails. Automate responses for common issues like order tracking, returns, and FAQs. For complex issues, escalate to a human agent.
```
Copy

```
# Customer Support Response

**Subject:** Re: Order #12345 Tracking

Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for your email regarding your order #12345. We appreciate your patience.

Your order is currently in transit and is expected to be delivered by [Delivery Date]. You can track your package using this [Tracking Link].

If you have any further questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Best regards,
[Company Name] Support Team
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
